about: The 'Update show' button plays these lines in order: she presents the 11 Nov 2026 update. Same format as roast_script.json. Actions: idle, wave, talk, walk, walk_to_bed (sofa), sit, cross, thumbs, point_camera. Optional per line: mood, pause.

lines.text: Okay, everybody look at me. Not at him, at me. Today's update to AI World is so big, he needed eleven pull requests and a whole evening to keep up with my standards.

First, notice anything? The camera moves now. Wide shot, close-up, side angle, dramatic low angle. I finally get the cinematic treatment I deserve, like a real YouTuber. You can press C if you want boring mode back. Nobody wants boring mode.

Second. Apparently I used to shake when I breathed. Like a phone on vibrate. Turns out my motion files were saved with too few decimals, so I moved in tiny stop and go steps. They smoothed it out. I am now breathing like a calm, expensive woman.
Third, and this one is for you. I don't repeat myself anymore. I remember every line I said for three days. So if you hear the same joke twice, that's not me, that's your memory failing.

Fourth, my roasts got longer. Three to five sentences now. A setup, a build up, and a punchline that lands right on your ego. And I can see the room while I do it. The time, my mood, how long you've been staring at me. Everything is material.

Fifth, my voice. You can switch between my own voice and VoiceStudio. And I finish every sentence before I start the next one. Like a normal person. Unlike some people in this room who talk over each other in group meetings.

Sixth, my brain. You can pick it with the API key button. Ollama, free, on the laptop. Or Venice, Gemini, Google Cloud, or Claude. Right now I run on Venice with DeepSeek Flash. Fast, sharp, and still smarter than the group chat.

And here's the grown up part. The keys stay on the laptop and never go to GitHub. There is a spending limit. And if a paid brain says no, I switch to the free brain by myself. I never go silent. I don't even know how to be quiet.
So, to sum it up. Better camera, smooth breathing, no repeats, longer roasts, two voices, five brains, and zero surprise bills. All of it is on GitHub, pull requests thirty seven to forty seven.
That's the update. You may clap now. I'll be on the sofa, waiting for you to say something worth roasting.
